children: AIOZ Network launched its Storage MCP Server on October 12, 2026, giving MCP-compatible AI agents programmatic access to 22 AIOZ Storage tools. Agents can manage S3 buckets, objects and upload links, create and query vectors, and control permissions through S3 and Vector Access Grants.

The server connects agent workflows to storage operations, creating a potential route for agent-driven storage demand paid through AIOZ. Its tools cover both stored objects and vectors, while access grants provide permission controls for those operations. The launch establishes tool availability, but the evidence does not establish adoption or revenue scale.
Connect. Prompt. Manage. The AIOZ Storage MCP Server is LIVE.
Give MCP-compatible agents access to 22 AIOZ Storage tools:
→ Work with S3 buckets, objects, and upload links
→ Create vector buckets and indexes, manage and query vectors

title: AIOZ Network: Storage MCP Server launches with 22 tools for AI agents - 12 Oct 2026
